findings.claim: Virtual Staging Solutions (@virtualstaging) has about 408 followers and its feed is mostly static single-image before-and-after staging renders, not reels or carousels, with posts running from 2021 to December 2025.
findings.sourceTitle: Virtual Staging Solutions (@virtualstaging) Instagram photos and videos

findings.claim: Ivy Lane Home Staging (@ivylanehome, Boulder, Denver and Fort Collins) has about 38.8K followers and mixes carousels of staging transformations, reels with styling tips and before-and-afters, and static finished-room images.
Ivy Lane Home Staging organizes 11 story highlights, including "Before + Afters", "Staging Tips", "Styling Tips", "Our Looks" and "About Us", and links followers to shop its looks.

Elite Home Staging & Design (@elitehomestaging, Southern California, verified, about 14.5K followers) posts before-and-after transformations, reels and project carousels, and uses highlights such as PRESS, REVIEWS, SOLD, WHY ELITE?, MODERN and ORGANIC to lean on social proof and style categories.

Home Staging Gals (@homestaginggals, Tampa Bay, about 3.8K followers) puts its HGTV "100 Day Dream Home" credit in the bio and posts a mix of before-and-after carousels, video clips and reels of individual rooms.
findings.sourceTitle: Home Staging Gals (@homestaginggals) Instagram photos and videos

findings.claim: Search listings show C&B Home Staging (@cb_staging, Columbus, Ohio) at about 42K followers and New Concept Home Staging (@newconcepthomestaging, Canada) at about 13K, positioning local physical stagers as the larger accounts in the niche.
findings.sourceTitle: C&B Home Staging (@cb_staging) Instagram photos and videos

findings.claim: HousingWire names Trolto the best AI virtual staging tool for social media video because it turns staged images into custom-branded cinematic fly-through videos and AI Instagram Reels, with a content calendar and direct scheduling to platforms.
findings.sourceTitle: Virtual Staging: The Best Apps for 2026 + Mind-Blowing AI picks

findings.claim: Virtual staging vendor ApplyDesign recommends four social content types: before-and-after visuals, behind-the-scenes looks at the staging process, client success stories and testimonials, and highlights of specific digitally enhanced features.
findings.sourceTitle: Virtual Staging and Social Media - Top Property Marketing Duo

findings.claim: Staged4more tells home stagers to post project photos on Instagram, make behind-the-scenes videos, share virtual tours of staged properties and feature client testimonials about how staging changed their listings.
findings.sourceTitle: 50 Marketing Ideas For Home Stagers to Generate Revenue - Staged4more

findings.claim: Shhots AI lists "before and after staging" among 10 real estate reel formats for 2026 and advises a hard cut from the empty frame to the staged frame rather than a dissolve, with the reveal landing within about two seconds.
findings.sourceTitle: Real Estate Reels: 10 Formats That Work in 2026

findings.claim: Shhots AI advises captioning staging reels as digitally staged, since most MLS rules require staged imagery to be disclosed as digitally enhanced and reels act as listing ads.
findings.sourceTitle: Real Estate Reels: 10 Formats That Work in 2026
